evidence_rows.finding: The 2024 UK PRTR dataset is an official 14 MB XML publication dated 30 June 2026.
The official PRTR guidance documents facility and parent company, geographical location and river basin, activity, pollutant or waste, environmental medium and off-site transfers.
Operator submissions are cross-checked against permits, inspections and monitoring, and reviewed for omissions, errors and incomplete information.
Official reporting methods include calculated, estimated, measured and unspecified categories with detailed sub-codes including C_ETS, C_IPCC, C_PER, M_ISO, M_PER and M_WEIGH.
A facility or pollutant may be absent because reporting thresholds were not reached or no release was reported; absence is not converted to zero without an explicit value.
The Environment Agency lists the 2024 Pollution Inventory as a ZIP resource updated 17 April 2026.
The Pollution Inventory covers annual mass releases to air, controlled waters and sewers, off-site waste transfers, and both point and fugitive sources across the whole permit.
The official dataset metadata specifies EPSG:27700 and an Environment Agency Conditional Licence whose special conditions must be retained.
EPR/HP3504MA is an effective permit issued 18 April 2019 to Thames Gateway Waste to Energy Limited for non-hazardous-waste incineration at Choats Road, grid TQ4833582947.

The official 2015 permit publication identifies EPR/CP3737CV/V003 at the same Thames Gateway Energy Facility location; it remains a separate historical or related permit identity until permit history is reconciled.

The local planning record for application 18/01501/FUL states a daily-average nitrogen dioxide limit of 150 mg/Nm3 and requires records for compliance assessment; this is a limit, not a measured annual release.
An outstanding Companies House charge created 14 May 2025 identifies land on the north side of Choats Road with HM Land Registry title TGL419520.
Earlier satisfied charges from 2021 to 2024 repeatedly identify the Choats Road property as title TGL419520, supporting title-number continuity but not exact boundary geometry.

Cory Barking Operations Limited is an active company formerly named McGrath Bros. (Waste Control) Limited; permits TP3697NP and FB3306HG share the operator but represent separate 54-60 and 62 River Road sites and must not be merged automatically.
